name: 시티드 딥스 머신
prompt:
Generate a 2-stage workout exercise illustration diagram:
- Title: 'SEATED DIP MACHINE'
- Pose 1 (Left - Starting Position): Muscular athletic male seated in a selectorized dip machine with thigh pads secured, gripping high parallel handles at waist level, elbows bent at 90 degrees with lower pecs stretched.
- Pose 2 (Right - Finish Position / Lockout): Pressing both handles downwards towards the seat base until arms are fully extended and locked out downwards, squeezing lower pecs and triceps.
- Muscle Highlight: Lower Pectoralis Major and Triceps Brachii glowing bright red-orange.
- Equipment: Commercial selectorized seated dip machine with weight stack and downward pressing levers.
- Style: 3D anatomical fitness model, realistic physique, clean white minimalist background, scientific fitness guide, side-by-side comparison diagram.

name: 케이블 오버헤드 익스텐션
